objective: Reduce physical mission completion wall time in native MuJoCo, preserve camera-only control and physical/protocol success.

baseline.conditions: open seed11 stored independent plan --overlap-start grasp

candidates.change: Only solo pending moving carry renewal within original TTL; speed policy unchanged

Only raise far box forward cap .08 to .12 and lateral cap .08 to .10, within existing CameraRobotPort limits; proportional .002 near control, reverse .05, staging stop/final waypoint, routes and permissions preserved.
candidates.repeat_condition: First candidate physical and protocol success, no contact/clearance/renewal invariant failure

acceptance: Both cargo physical placement/release and protocol complete
Record wall/SIM speed, phase duration, decision and command counts, strict loaded concurrency
No robot-robot contact, carried cargo sampled floor contact or artificial weld
Original RGB timestamps, maximum .25 lease, no expired-command revival, current gate/plan authority
Each candidate committed before run; source and assets remain fixed during run; preserve failed runs
stop_conditions: Failure or safety invariant failure stops that candidate cohort for review
No automatic budget extension or lowered success threshold
A final successful candidate is repeated once within the stated remaining budget
limits: One known saved plan/open map/seed only
No new LLM communication or physical robot generalization
